evidence: src/infrastructure/InMemoryTaskRepository.ts: class InMemoryTaskRepository implements TaskRepository with a private Map<string, Task>, which is a persistence adapter.
save(task) only calls this.tasks.set(task.id, task), with no validation or domain rules.
getByProjectId, getByProjectIdAndStatus and getByProjectIdAndAssignee only filter stored tasks by field equality to answer queries.

parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryTaskRepository is a persistence adapter. It implements the domain TaskRepository port and stores tasks in a Map. Its only methods are save, getById and three query methods that filter by projectId, status and assigneeId. Filtering by these fields is how the repository answers queries; it is not a business rule. Nothing in the file checks invariants, state transitions, authorization or other domain policy, and it has no transport or presentation logic. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer.
